origin: ROOT scientific intent rules from twelve public question stems; no reference file has been opened in this round
primary_scoring: Unchanged original EM and token F1 from evaluation/metrics/scoring.py; references ROOT-local after every generation process is closed.
secondary_scoring: Whole-answer equivalence only within an explicit class below. NFKC/casefold/whitespace normalization first. No substring answer scoring, negation stripping, unit/sign removal or post-output additions.
retrieval_labels: Exploratory deterministic lexical relationship labels, not human judgments or scientific truth. A chunk is rule-positive only when all groups of one sufficiency rule match its full text. Alias/answer-word mention alone is a separate weaker coverage indicator.
precision_denominator: Rule-positive selected chunks / five selected chunks in each RAG arm.
recall_denominator: Rule-positive selected chunks / distinct rule-positive chunks in the frozen union of normal dense top-five and all twenty RRF candidates for that question. NULL if zero positives. This is candidate-pool Recall@5, not full-corpus recall.
coverage: Candidate word mention and relationship-positive counts; corpus lexical scans, when present, use only scoped active textbook chunks. No-match cannot establish scientific absence or complete corpus coverage.
rerank_harm: MiniLM-specific ordering harm means fewer rule-positive top-five chunks after MiniLM than the original RRF top-five drawn from the identical twenty-candidate pool. Hybrid versus dense selection differences are a separate overall pipeline comparison. Answer score changes are reported separately; these diagnostic counts alone do not prove a causal scientific error.
generation_policy: All three arms may use own scientific knowledge, all receive the same OpenQA instructions and JSON shape. NoRAG receives an empty evidence list; dense and hybrid receive their frozen five full chunks. Question order fixed; arm order rotated by question index.

questions.ambiguity: The stem gives no altitude/location; exact expected completion is ROOT-local and the supplementary class is deliberately narrow.

limits: Twelve already-seen failures are a diagnostic DEV sample, not a held-out benchmark.
Lexical rules can miss synonyms and can match unrelated neighboring text; inspect these separately from answer accuracy.
A single pair of provider calls cannot establish a stable latency improvement, p95 or native end-to-end speed.
